# XGRC® Software

> XGRC® Software is a governance, risk and compliance (GRC) platform. Specialist
> solutions for safety, risk, information security, ESG, environmental compliance,
> assurance and third-party governance run on one secure, auditable data
> foundation, so risks, controls, obligations and evidence stay connected rather
> than scattered across spreadsheets and disconnected tools. XGRC® serves
> compliance, risk, internal audit and SHEQ/EHS teams at mid-to-large enterprises.
> Part of the Strategix Group.

## Platform

- [GRC Platform overview](https://xgrcsoftware.com/grc-software): How the XGRC® platform connects governance, risk and compliance on one data foundation.
- [All solutions](https://xgrcsoftware.com/solutions): The full XGRC® solution suite at a glance.
- [Use cases](https://xgrcsoftware.com/use-cases): Compliance, risk, audit and safety problems XGRC® is used to solve, by discipline and standard.

## Solutions

- [SHEQX®](https://xgrcsoftware.com/sheqx): Safety, health, environment and quality management aligned to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001.
- [MSXCyber®](https://xgrcsoftware.com/msxcyber): Information security management (ISMS) aligned to ISO 27001:2022, with GDPR and POPIA support.
- [Enterprise Risk Management](https://xgrcsoftware.com/erm): Structured, auditable enterprise, operational and project risk aligned to ISO 31000 and COSO.
- [ESG](https://xgrcsoftware.com/esg): ESG data management and governance for consistent, auditable sustainability reporting.
- [ENVIRX®](https://xgrcsoftware.com/envirx): Environmental compliance and performance monitoring with auditable environmental records.
- [Integrated Assurance](https://xgrcsoftware.com/integrated-assurance): Internal audit and combined assurance linked directly to risks, controls and actions.
- [XGRC® Compliance Hub](https://xgrcsoftware.com/compliance-hub): Supplier, contractor and third-party compliance through structured onboarding, vetting and ongoing assurance.
- [XLOGIC®](https://xgrcsoftware.com/xlogic): Converts policies, frameworks, controls and obligations into structured workflows with accountability and evidence capture.
- [MSX®](https://xgrcsoftware.com/msx): An integrated programme that coordinates multiple XGRC® disciplines into one management system.
- [MAIA®](https://xgrcsoftware.com/maia): Governed AI for GRC — business intelligence and intelligent agents with a full AI interaction audit trail.
- [XRM](https://xgrcsoftware.com/xrm): An auditable CRM for leads, opportunities, quotes and customer relationships, built with the same governance discipline as the rest of XGRC®.

## Partner solutions

- [Libryo](https://xgrcsoftware.com/libryo): Jurisdiction-specific regulatory intelligence embedded within XGRC®.
- [Hakware](https://xgrcsoftware.com/hakware): AI-powered penetration testing and unified vulnerability visibility.
